messages:
Asif (Sales): Heads up — Boldline just pushed back on our standard 99.9% hosted SLA. They want 99.99% uptime and a p50 latency SLO of 200ms for text-generation endpoints, plus 24x7 critical support. They want the ask included in the contract draft this week. Can product confirm feasibility and routing for escalation?

Maya (PM): Thanks Asif. Can you paste the volume/traffic expectations and whether they require multi-region active-active? 99.99% is doable but will likely require Dedicated or Private offering and explicit failover/rollout policies. Quick checklist I need: expected TPS, token/sec at peak, regions, data residency req, and desired credit model for SLA misses.

Asif (Sales): Early numbers: ~350 rps peak, estimated 12M tokens/day, primary in us-west + eu-west, they want EU data residency. Will confirm exact concurrency tomorrow. no active-active initially, but want fallback in case region outage.

Jia (Support): Current hosted baseline (prod telemetry last 30d): p50 ~120ms global for small-context gen, p95 ~420ms, p99 ~780ms. Uptime (hosted infra) tracked at 99.97% global last quarter (but that includes short network blips). Two things to flag: 1) p50 200ms target is close to our p50 for simple prompts — but p50 depends heavily on sequence length and model. 2) 99.99% means very small downtime budget (≈8.6 minutes/month). We should scope options: Dedicated pool with reserved GPUs + cross-region failover, or Private (VPC) with customer infra and our control plane.

Noah (Eng): Quick engineering notes — to hit 200ms p50 for gen at 350 rps we need: reserved capacity (dedicated gpus), optimized batching params, and KV cache warmup for cold-starts. Possible routing layout: primary region -> healthy replica fallback -> throttled degrade mode (smaller model) -> queue with SLA hitless routing. Example config snippet we might propose for the contract: 

```
"sla": {
  "uptime": "99.99%",
  "latency": { "p50": "200ms", "p95": "500ms" },
  "support_tier": "Critical (24x7)",
  "fallback_policy": "dedicated->replica->degrade",
  "reserved_capacity": "350rps_peak"
}
```

Also need to know token distribution (short prompts vs long) — p50 will be dominated by short prompts, but p95/p99 blow up with long sequences. If they accept p95 500ms that buys us more headroom. Cost impact: reserved capacity + multi-region + SRE on-call adds a sizable uplift (~30-50% on monthly charges).

Sam (Legal): From contract side, two asks: define how SLA downtime is measured (region vs global), include maintenance windows (should be excluded and capped), and SLO credits formula. Also clarify remediation timeline and escalation contact for 24x7. We typically avoid absolute uptime guarantees for hosted shared infra — Dedicated/Private is preferred for 99.99.

Maya (PM): Proposed next steps: 1) Sales to confirm concurrency and token profiles (Asif). 2) Product & Eng to draft a scope doc with two options: (A) Dedicated reserved pool + cross-region failover + 24x7 on-call (costly), (B) Private deployment in customer VPC with our control plane (higher setup fee, better isolation). 3) Legal to sketch SLA language and credit model. 4) If Sales confirms high priority, mark as P0 intake and queue for expedited review this sprint. I'll create a product intake issue with checklist and estimated RAs.

Asif (Sales): Got it — I'll pull token hist and confirm by EOD. Boldline prefers hosted but may accept Dedicated if costs are reasonable.

oncall-bot: ticket #INF-4872 created for "Boldline SLA intake - 99.99% uptime / 200ms p50" assigned to product-triage.

Maya (PM): tagging @Noah and @Jia for initial cost/ops estimate. Please drop rough estimates in the intake doc once Noah has hardware sizing. :thumbsup:

Noah (Eng): Will sketch sizing later today. Rough back-of-envelope: to achieve p50 200ms at 350rps with 95th percentile headroom, look at 4 x A100-class GPUs in dedicated pool + warm KV cache strategy, plus replica in eu-west for residency/failover.

Jia (Support): I'll prepare runbook and proposed escalation matrix for 24x7 coverage.

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll open the intake issue and tag the stakeholders. We'll aim to have a recommendation by Wednesday.
